Third-party license for the files in this directory
====================================================

Component
---------

    Select2 Bootstrap 5 Theme — a Sass partial set that re-skins Select2 for
    Bootstrap 5. It contains no compiled CSS; the deck's SassC compile
    consumes these partials directly.

    Upstream: https://github.com/select2/select2-bootstrap-5-theme
    Files:    ./src/*.scss  (disabled, dropdown, input-group, layout,
              multiple, single, sizing, validation, variables)

Copyright
---------

**None of the vendored files states a copyright line.** They open with a
Sass comment naming a group of variables and nothing else (`_variables.scss`
begins `// Height`, then `$s2bs5-height:`). The upstream project is named
here from the files' own embedded metadata: the `$s2bs5-` variable prefix
every partial uses, and this directory's position as the plugin's own
`vendor/select2-bootstrap-5-theme` tree in the Decko bootstrap mod. No
copyright holder is asserted for these bytes beyond what upstream publishes
at the URL above.

License: the MIT License, reproduced in full below. Upstream publishes its
copy at
https://github.com/select2/select2-bootstrap-5-theme/blob/master/LICENSE.

Version
-------

The vendored files state no version number, and none is claimed here. The
partial set is against Select2 4.x and Bootstrap 5 (`$input-height`,
`$form-select-padding-y`, `$zindex-modal` — Bootstrap 5 variable names),
and it is the theme the compiled deck selects at load
(`script_load_select2.js.coffee`: `select2.defaults.set("theme",
"bootstrap-5")`).

Scope of the MIT grant inside this project
------------------------------------------

MIT is permissive and GPL-compatible, so vendoring these bytes does not
